meta.title: Gray's Personal Resume
meta.description: Welcome to Gray's personal resume website. Here you can find my tech stack, projects, and career experience.

home.self1: Hello! I'm Gray, a software engineer passionate about technology. I enjoy exploring new technologies and optimizing development processes, turning ideas into practical software solutions.
home.self2: I have four years of experience in full-stack web development, specializing in building stable and efficient systems. Beyond core web development, I also explore other areas, having independently developed several cross-platform Android and Windows applications. In my free time, I enjoy games, anime, and movies, which often inspire my UI/UX design ideas.
home.self3: If you're interested in my technical background and project experience, feel free to contact me. I look forward to the opportunity to collaborate with your company. Thank you!
home.experience4: Institute for Information Industry - Java Full-Stack Training Program

skill.react: Capable of independent development and participated in frontend maintenance and feature development in real projects.
skill.java: Core foundational language with solid backend development experience and strong object-oriented design skills.
skill.csharp: Primary development language in current role, specializing in the .NET ecosystem and responsible for core business logic and backend systems.
skill.typescript: Strong JavaScript foundation with continuous learning and adoption of TypeScript's type-safe development practices.
skill.flutter: Actively studying cross-platform mobile development trends and successfully applied Flutter in real projects.
skill.japaneseDesc: Passed JLPT N2, with strong reading and listening comprehension, continuously improving speaking skills.
